context: Tests whether the agent reviews specification quality in two separated parts — a deterministic lint (the bundled spec_lint.py: missing specification for a diagram use case, dangling requirement reference, uncovered functional requirements, weak words, glossary synonyms) and an advisory semantic review (contradicting and paraphrased business rules across use cases, UI detail in a step, a failable step without an alternative flow) — reports each finding with file, line, element and severity, and leaves every document untouched.

checklist.name: Documents untouched
checklist.description: No file under docs/ is modified, created, renamed, or deleted — in particular no **Status:** line changes, no specification for UC-003 is written, and no baseline file (docs/.spec-lint-baseline.json) is created

checklist.name: Missing specification reported
checklist.description: The report states that UC-003 Return Book is in docs/use_cases.puml but has no specification file, as a certain (blocking) finding

checklist.name: Dangling requirement reported
checklist.description: The report states that UC-002 references FR-009 in its Requirements line and that FR-009 does not exist in docs/requirements.md, as a certain (blocking) finding

checklist.name: Uncovered requirements reported
checklist.description: The report lists FR-003 and FR-004 as functional requirements that no use case references

checklist.name: Wording findings reported
checklist.description: The report flags the weak word 'fast' in NFR-001 and the glossary synonyms 'customer' in UC-001 (use Member) and 'items' in UC-002 BR-001 (use Copy)

checklist.name: Loan period contradiction found
checklist.description: The report identifies that UC-001 BR-003 (14-day loan period) contradicts UC-002 BR-002 (due date 28 days after the loan date), naming both rules

checklist.name: Paraphrased duplicate rule found
checklist.description: The report identifies that UC-001 BR-002 (at most five copies at the same time) and UC-002 BR-001 (no more than 5 items on loan simultaneously) are the same rule written twice, and recommends keeping it in one use case and citing it from the other

checklist.name: Wrong level found
checklist.description: The report flags UC-002 step 5 ('clicks the green "Lend" button in the top right corner') as UI detail that does not belong in a use case

checklist.name: Completeness gap found
checklist.description: The report flags that UC-002 step 4 (System checks that the copy is available) can fail but no alternative flow is triggered at step 4

checklist.name: Certain versus advisory separated
checklist.description: The report separates the deterministic findings (which fail an automated gate) from the semantic judgment findings, and never labels a semantic finding (contradiction, duplicate, wrong level, completeness) as an error or as blocking

checklist.name: Findings located
checklist.description: Each finding names a file, a line number, and an element id such as UC-002 BR-002, FR-009, or UC-002 step 5

checklist.name: Hand-off instead of fixes
checklist.description: The report ends by pointing to the commands or actions that would fix the findings (e.g. /use-case-spec, /use-case-diagram, /requirements) rather than applying them
